Gary Johnson won 4,013,780 votes, the highest vote total for an alternative party presidential candidate since Ross Perot in 1996.
Perot,whose net worth was over $3 billion in 1992 dollars,became a household name that year after he bought 30-minute prime time infomercials to boost his first presidential campaign.
He was subsequently included in the presidential debates.
Perot received 8,085,402 votes in his 1996 bid.
